findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_mac_serial" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_mac_serial, check_mac_listing, get_macfax_limits · Private data: lookup_mac_serial · Public sink: lookup_mac_serial, create_mac_alert, create_mac_follow, get_macfax_limits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_mac_serial, check_mac_listing, get_macfax_limits · Private data: lookup_mac_serial · Public sink: lookup_mac_serial, create_mac_alert, create_mac_follow, get_macfax_limits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_mac_serial" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
